guards.body: BEGIN IF SUBSTRING_INDEX(USER(),'@',1)='__UPMS_RUNTIME__' AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM employees e WHERE e.id=NEW.employee_id AND e.active=1 AND BINARY CAST(e.id AS CHAR)=BINARY JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(NEW.employee_snapshot,'$.id')) AND e.version=JSON_EXTRACT(NEW.employee_snapshot,'$.version') AND BINARY e.name=BINARY JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(NEW.employee_snapshot,'$.name'))) OR CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(NEW.reason))<3 OR CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(NEW.reference))<1 OR NEW.reference_key<>SHA2(LOWER(TRIM(NEW.reference)),256) OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM money_batches b JOIN money_accounts a ON a.id=b.from_account_id WHERE b.id=NEW.money_batch_id AND b.from_account_id=NEW.money_account_id AND b.amount=NEW.amount AND b.date=NEW.date AND b.actor_id=NEW.actor_id AND b.kind='SOURCE_DEBIT' AND b.source_type='EXTERNAL' AND BINARY b.source_ref=BINARY CONCAT('UPMS-LABOR:',NEW.id) AND ((NEW.method='CASH' AND a.type='CASH_HOLDER') OR (NEW.method='BANK_TRANSFER' AND a.type='BANK'))) OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM labor_openings o WHERE o.employee_id=NEW.employee_id AND o.date<=NEW.date)) THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='UPMS_LABOR_PROTECTED'; END IF; END
